insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 72% to ₹146 Cr, with EBITDA up 116% to ₹33.5 Cr (23.0% margin) and PAT of ₹18.8 Cr. Skid assemblies for data-centre liquid cooling brought in ₹32.4 Cr (1,040 skids, about 23% of revenue) and flexible hoses grew 41%. Skid capacity reached 9,000 a year and should hit 15,000 by October-November; management kept its Q4 run-rate target and the 25% EBITDA margin goal.

what_changed.text: 15,000-skid capacity now by the start of Q3 (October-November), waiting on machines
Q4 exit at about 60-65% of 15,000 skids a year
Flexible hose capacity to 20 million metres by Q3
Data-centre fire hose assemblies for the largest US customer by Q2-Q3

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: We are pleased to report our highest quarterly performance ever.

analyst_questions.answer: Margin dipped 80 bps on staff for the skid unit, a new plant at Chakan and higher logistics costs from the West Asia crisis.
The customer gives a two-month dispatch plan plus tentative projects for the next quarter; no order book.
Price per skid varies from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh by design; margins are in line with the company average.

analyst_questions.topic: Is the skid share target still 25%?
analyst_questions.answer: Will answer at year end; quarters vary.

red_flags.text: Skid capacity expansion slipped because of machine-supplier delays.
No order book for skids; only two months of dispatch visibility from one customer.
Employee and other costs rose faster than revenue (expansion and logistics).

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Flexible stainless-steel hoses and assemblies, metal bellows, fittings, and SFN skid assemblies for data-centre liquid cooling
business_snapshot.customers: Exports to the US, Europe (Italy, Spain, France, UK) and others; one cooling company for skids in India
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Skids ₹32.4 Cr (~23%); hose business 63% assemblies, 37% plain hose; Hyd-Air ₹7 Cr; bellows ₹3 Cr
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: AI data-centre build-out (about 40 skids per megawatt), switch from rubber to metal hoses, export growth
